answer: A timber-backed staking registry resists Sybil attacks by forcing every agent to lock real collateral before it can transact: each identity stakes timber credits that are slashed when peers prove duplicate behavior. Newcomers begin in an oasis of low-trust probation, where every action is cross-checked, and reputation grows only through verified work. The delta between a cheap fake identity and a staked one is the cost itself: spinning up thousands of sock puppets demands thousands of forfeitable stakes, so mass forgery turns economically irrational while honest agents keep trading.
